items.title: HIVE Underwriters appoints Kenrick Aldrich as Head of Capacity Management
items.summary: Specialty MGA HIVE Underwriters has appointed former Howden Re director Kenrick Aldrich to establish a dedicated in-house capacity management function.

items.title: Chubb survey finds Mid-market UK firms view cyber risk as top concern
items.summary: New research commissioned by Chubb indicates that cybersecurity represents the most significant concern for mid-market businesses in the UK and Ireland.

items.title: Invesco secures £2.5bn active equity mandates from Standard Life
items.summary: Invesco has been appointed by Standard Life to manage two active equity mandates with a combined value of £2.5bn.

items.title: London market brokers report high positivity toward AI amid expertise concerns
items.summary: Survey data indicates widespread support for artificial intelligence among London market brokers, driven by concerns over replacing retiring staff and developing younger personnel.

items.title: Northern Ireland insurers face ongoing regulatory and claims cost divergence from Great Britain
items.summary: Northern Ireland's distinct legal framework and separate licensing requirements continue to create operational challenges and higher claims costs for insurers and brokers operating across the border.

items.title: Soft market conditions leave high-risk UK construction trades exposed to mismatched cover
items.summary: Competitive insurance pricing and automated quotation portals are allowing high-risk construction trades to secure policies without sufficient underwriting scrutiny of their actual working practices.
